about_the_game:
Tralalero Tralala: Survive the Night is an asymmetric horror game where four survivors face a terrifying Italian monster-maniac. Your goal is to survive the night and avoid turning into the next horrifying creature from Italian folklore.

Gameplay

Survival: At the start of each match, one player becomes the maniac in the form of one of the Italian monsters and hunts the other players. The survivors must complete quests and escape before the monster catches them.

Features

Italian Monsters: Play as unique creatures from Italian folklore—Tralalero Tralala, Br Br Br Patapim, Trippi Troppa, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, and the relentless DEATHRAY, a vengeful wraith that blinds its victims with bursts of spectral light before striking in silence.

Logical Quests: Solve puzzles and complete tasks to move closer to your escape.

Unpredictability: The monster could be lurking anywhere, adding tension and adrenaline to every match.

Authentic Sound Design: All sound effects and the Italian monsters' voiceovers create an atmosphere of genuine horror.
